synthesis.body: When a rename touches a name-that-is-an-identifier (filename, directory, package), the per-task line-level audit in the plan must list every string-literal occurrence — including module docstrings, header comments, assertion messages, help strings, and CLI-arg examples — not just code constants. The brief's `grep` Done-when test surfaces every site; the plan's per-task list is what executes against it. If the plan enumerates only constants, docstrings drift past EXECUTE and the post-EXECUTE adversarial-reviewer raises them as Blockers. Caught on PR#22 (relocate adapter contract to docs/contracts/): the round-1 plan listed only `CONTRACT_PATH` / `SCHEMA_PATH` constants in T3/T4; round-2 post-EXECUTE review found 14 docstring + assertion-message hits the audit had missed. Fix: when the reference taxonomy says 'Class X always rewrites', the per-task audit's grep must cover docstrings, comments, and message strings in the same sweep.

title: Rename audits must enumerate docstring + comment + error-message sites, not just code constants
